messages:
Maya (Design): Quick sync: compact dashboard rows look crowded at 8px. Users want density but keyboard/touch must be preserved. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.local/ui/compact-rows.png
Jon (Frontend): Agreed. Also saw focus disappear on the expander when rows collapse. Likely CSS stacking.
Lina (PM): Can we increase to 10px vertical padding for compact mode? Keeps density but helps targets.
Sam (Dev): 10px sounds safe. The chevron expander is ~36px right now; a11y-bot: targets must be >=44x44px. We should add padding to reach minimum.
Maya (Design): Plan: keep icon-only button visually, add visually-hidden text "Expand row"/"Collapse row", aria-expanded toggle, and tooltip. Update theme: add compact alias mapping (compact.rowGap = 10) without renaming tokens.
a11y-bot: PR checklist: aria-expanded, focus order, hit target >=44x44, screenreader text, contrast check.
Jon (Frontend): I'll patch focus rules and padding:
```
.row-expander:focus{outline:2px solid var(--interactive-focus);outline-offset:2px}
.row-content{padding:10px 0}
```
Also will bump toast.offsetTop by 8px in compact theme to avoid overlap with header when multiple expands fire.
Lina (PM): Ship as patch (3.2.1), non-breaking, no token renames.
Sam (Dev): I'll review Percy snapshots post-CI. Can pair to confirm no regressions.
Maya (Design): I'll update token doc with compact alias and post notes. Thanks!
